# NeelStack Solutions — Complete Context & Documentation

> NeelStack Solutions Private Limited is an enterprise AI engineering and custom software development company incorporated in Uttar Pradesh, India (CIN: U62011UP2026PTC250857). We design, architect, and deploy production AI systems (LLMs, RAG, autonomous multi-agent swarms, Model Context Protocol tools), high-throughput SaaS platforms, and enterprise digital solutions.

## 2. Core Product Portfolio

### DhruvaOS (School Operating System)
- Target: Schools, K-12 Academies, Colleges, Universities, and Educational Trusts
- Launch Timeline: Beta live October 2026 · Full Public Launch November 14, 2026
- Architectural Highlights: Unified EdOS unifying admissions, automated fee reconciliation, biometric & RFID attendance, multi-lingual parent communications, and AI curricular lesson planning.
- URL: https://neelstack.com/products/dhruvaos

### ToolVines (Browser-Native Developer Platform)
- Target: Software engineers, security auditors, DevOps architects, designers, and privacy officers
- Status: Live Product (https://toolvines.com)
- Architectural Highlights: 320+ developer utilities, cryptography formatters, PDF tools, and media transcoders executing 100% client-side via Rust WebAssembly with zero data sent to remote servers.
- URL: https://neelstack.com/products/toolvines

### AI Company OS (Autonomous AI Workforce Platform)
- Target: Mid-market enterprises and automated business operations
- Status: Research & Development / Whitepaper v1.0 Published
- Architectural Highlights: 11 specialized executive and operational AI agent squads orchestrated via LangGraph cyclic state machines, Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool integration, and human-in-the-loop authorization gates.
- URL: https://neelstack.com/products/ai-company-os
- Whitepaper: https://neelstack.com/whitepapers/ai-company-operating-system

### Planned Concepts
- NaukariMitra: Independent AI-powered competitive exam preparation companion providing syllabus vector RAG and vernacular mentoring (https://neelstack.com/products/naukarimitra).
- SarkariMitra: Independent citizen assistance engine for Central and State government schemes with 100% official .gov.in redirects (https://neelstack.com/products/sarkarimitra).

## 3. Technology Stack & Architecture Standards

- Frontend: Next.js 16 (App Router, Turbopack, React 19 Server Components), Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion
- Client-Side WASM: Rust compiled to WebAssembly via wasm-pack
- Backend & Microservices: Python FastAPI, Node.js, Go
- AI Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Microsoft GraphRAG, pgvector
- Databases: PostgreSQL with physical schema-level multi-tenancy and Row-Level Security (RLS), Redis
- Security: TLS 1.3, AES-256 at rest, DPDP Act 2023 compliance, zero vendor lock-in
